# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen in the fall of her first school year; sixteen by the end of the series volume.  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Student, later schoolteacher at White Sands  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. He is described as being remarkably handsome and growing up to look tall, manly, and very much like his father.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, determined, and possesses a strong ambition to excel. He is naturally teasing, cheerful, and popular among his peers, yet capable of deep chivalry and quiet self-sacrifice. He holds a good-natured attitude towards rivalry and is eager to resolve past conflicts, showing maturity and independence.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_

## Traits

- Teasing and mischievous  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>
- Ambitious and hardworking  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>
- Magnanimous and self-sacrificing  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- Proud and independent  <sub>[v1 c28 P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academic excellence (scholastic rival in English, geometry, Latin, and mathematics)  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>
- Recitation and public speaking  <sub>[v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>
- Rowing  <sub>[v1 c28 P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- To win academic honors such as the Queen's Academy Medal and earn his own way through college  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>
- To make peace and establish a genuine friendship with Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

## History

After returning from Alberta, Gilbert resumed his studies at Avonlea school in the fourth book. On his first day back, he teased Anne Shirley by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' leading to Anne smashing her slate over his head and harboring a long-standing grudge against him despite his immediate apology. Gilbert quickly established himself as Anne's chief academic rival. After completing his Entrance examinations, he attended Queen's Academy in Charlottetown to earn a First Class teacher's license in one year, where he won the Governor-General's Medal. Because his father could not afford to send him to college immediately, Gilbert planned to teach school to pay his own way. Upon learning that Anne wished to stay in Avonlea to care for Marilla following Matthew's death, Gilbert generously gave up his secured position at the Avonlea school so that Anne could teach there, accepting a post at White Sands instead. After this act of kindness, Anne stopped him on the road, and they finally forgave each other and became fast friends.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Spent three years living in Alberta with his father for the latter's health, falling behind in his schooling as a result  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Son of John Blythe, a former suitor of Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
